dimension_description: Temperature measures how hot or cold a system is, but on a deeper level it tracks the distribution of energy among microscopic degrees of freedom. This makes it one of the rare scales that links kitchen experience, planetary climate, stellar interiors, and particle collisions. Many values are quoted directly in kelvin, while others are converted from Celsius or Fahrenheit values reported in the source.
